title: three guard cards: the tripwire in doctor, the REDCap host on egress, refused licences (card H-65)
note: plan 9 cards 9g-11, 9g-14 and 9g-15, decision D-1348; no box, no root, no Docker here

findings.claim: the REDCap egress row covers only TB_REDCAP_API_URL: with TB_EDC_BACKEND unset the study link calls the URL saved on the S36 page (orchestrator StudyService.client), whose host still needs an EGRESS_EXTRA line, and a private address needs it for the in-process guard too

declared_egress in libs/tb_common/http.py does not carry the REDCap row of deploy/egress.py; the connector declares its host per call so nothing is refused today, and the test that holds the two tables together sets no REDCap URL
the second half of review 01 B1-P2 is not built: the launch record does not print the PHI tripwire setting on its first line

the licence refusal reads what an allow-list entry records: an unknown entry that records a wrong licence for an FSL or SSPL component would still accept it; the licence report has no refused class of its own
